english.note: Use this as the all-purpose colloquial choice for a person, force, team, or opponent that is powerful; when strong means hard to defeat, it describes a person or team rather than a physical position.
This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for a person, thing, or force that is powerful or strong.

exampleSentences.jyutping: go2 deoi6 bo1 daa2 dak1 hou2 ging6

english.note: Use this for a person, opponent, or force that is impressively powerful or difficult to deal with.

exampleSentences.english: Our opponent is formidable in this match, so we cannot underestimate them.
exampleSentences.traditional: 今場對手好勁，我哋唔可以睇少佢。
exampleSentences.jyutping: gam1 coeng4 deoi3 sau2 hou2 ging6 ngo5 dei6 m4 ho2 ji5 tai2 siu2 keoi5

english.note: This is the all-purpose casual choice for a very strong or powerful person or thing, and it can also praise an impressive achievement.

exampleSentences.english: That engine is mighty; it can pull such a heavy lorry uphill.
exampleSentences.traditional: 嗰副引擎真係勁，咁重架貨車都拉得上斜。
exampleSentences.jyutping: go2 fu3 jan5 king4 zan1 hai6 ging6 gam3 cung5 gaa3 fo3 ce1 dou1 laai1 dak1 soeng5 ce3

english.note: Use this as the all-purpose casual choice for something powerful or having a strong effect.

exampleSentences.english: This cleaner is really potent; grease comes off with one wipe.
exampleSentences.traditional: 呢款清潔劑真係好勁，油污一抹就甩。
